known_differences: Both native Stitch screens invent performance numbers, article details and simplified illustrations. The hosted draft uses dated public official HTML, styles and media instead.

Tracking, analytics, consent injection and Intellimize scripts were removed. The source Webflow and presentation runtimes remain on public third-party CDNs; motion, tabs, carousels and video behaviour are not fully verified on the static host.
One unused Webflow announcement-bar placeholder SVG returned HTTP 403; its four empty-alt placeholder tags were omitted from the static draft.
Rendered side-by-side desktop/mobile comparison with the current official site remains pending; exact visual parity is unverified.
